title: Hanoi: Over 1.6 Tons of Trash Collected at World Cleanup Day 2023
author: Nguyen Tra
summary: On the morning of August 26, more than 500 volunteers attended the “World Cleanup Day 2023” event on Pham Hung Street, Nam Tu Liem District (Hanoi).

contentBlocks.value: On the morning of August 26, more than 500 volunteers attended the “World Cleanup Day 2023” event on Pham Hung Street, Nam Tu Liem District (Hanoi).

World Cleanup Day 2023 was organized to raise community awareness and call on the community to take joint action for a green environment.

The event was launched by the Let's Do It! Hanoi project with the participation of more than 500 volunteers of various ages, sponsored by Mien A Dong Co., Ltd. (EASIA TRAVEL).

The total amount of waste collected on Pham Hung Street was over 1.6 tons, consisting mainly of plastic cups, medical masks, and cigarette butts.

Before the event, volunteers were trained by Let's Do It! Hanoi on how to sort waste and given safety instructions for collection, and were provided with gloves, litter pickers, and collection sacks.

Ms. Nguyen Thi Cam Tu, Project Lead of Let's Do It! Hanoi, shared: “This year's Cleanup Day in Hanoi attracted people of all ages, from young children joining their parents, students, to senior citizens. This was both an occasion to spread the message of environmental protection widely throughout the community, and an opportunity for everyone to see more clearly the current state of Hanoi's environment.”

Let's Do It! Hanoi is a member of Let's Do It! Vietnam, part of the Let's Do It! World network of organizations. Founded in June 2018, through its core activity of cleanups, Let's Do It! Hanoi aims to raise public awareness of the current environmental situation, particularly the issues of plastic waste and littering.

At the same time, to help reduce “trash blindness” — becoming numb to the sight of litter — and encourage people to reduce littering through concrete actions such as limiting single-use plastics, disposing of waste properly, sorting waste correctly, and recycling and reusing at home, the campaign works to create a cleaner environment in Hanoi and improve the current environmental situation.

World Cleanup Day is the world's largest civic campaign for the environment, aiming to bring together 5% of the world's population to clean up and reduce waste in a single day.

The World Cleanup Day campaign, together with the Let's Do It! World organization, was proud to receive the “Best Mobiliser” award (the top mobilization campaign among UN SDG campaigns) in July 2023.
